10-demo regression sweep PASS (todomvc_r660 6.86s / double_click_r663 2.00s / todomvc_r664 5.87s / todomvc_r665 13.25s / todomvc_r666 7.06s / settings_panel_r667 2.09s / settings_panel_r668 0.87s / settings_panel_r669 2.50s / r670a_carry_clearance 1.54s / hello_multi_window_r670b 2.62s) — zero regression bit-identical.

todomvc_r665 mid-refactor regression detection — the initial R670.B refactor missed the R51.147 `any_animation_active → redraw_requested` parity in compute_paint_scene_for_window, which caused the second-delete click in r665 to fire against a stale paint-scene snapshot (no repaint between RPC dispatches without state_change). Detected via the 9-demo regression sweep mid-refactor (after AppShell + dispatch_rpc changes landed); resolved by extending compute_paint_scene_for_window with the same animation-loop heartbeat block compute_paint_scene already had. Honest carry: substrate parity between the two paint scene producers MUST mirror exactly — any future divergence (e.g. theme reactivity, hot-reload hooks) needs the same mirror.

hello-multi-window first dogfood verified end-to-end — main + inspector scene/snapshot return content-disjoint scenes (main has main_btn tag absent from inspector; inspector has inspector_state_text tag absent from main). State propagation main → inspector works through shared ShellCore: scene/click on main_btn flips ButtonState Idle→Hover; subsequent scene/snapshot {window:'inspector'} renders 'Hover' text. scene/invoke /external/send Disable → inspector renders 'Disabled'. Unknown window id ('definitely_not_a_real_window') falls back to primary per AppShell::resolve_spec_id rather than hard-erroring.

AccessKit per-window adapter pin — each WindowSlot carries its own accesskit_winit::Adapter (AccessKit canonical: 1 adapter = 1 window, multi-window = multi-adapter NOT auto-merged, mirroring macOS NSAccessibility / GTK Atk semantics). Pre-R670.B AppShell carried `accesskit: Option<accesskit_winit::Adapter>` for the single window; R670.B WindowSlot.accesskit per-slot. Existing single-window bindings see one adapter as before; multi-window bindings get one adapter per WindowSpec.
carry_forward_bullets: R671 axis selection — northern-star anchor. Phase B widget catalog (Menu / Dialog / Toolbar / TreeView / Table / Tabs / DatePicker; R750+ entry) is the most direct Phase B build-out. Phase C §2 #4 dual execution substrate (ImmediateModeNode + game loop; R1000+ early prep) is the larger northern-star mass (Phase C 35% + Phase D 35% = 70% of northern-star). Phase D editor self-hosted prep (DevTools TreeView + property-grid; R2500+ early thinking) builds directly on R670.B hello-multi-window inspector pattern.

scene/layout {viewport: null} is single-binding-scoped (one last_paint_layout per ShellCore); multi-window per-window layout snapshots would need a per-WindowSlot last_paint_layout field. Substrate-incompleteness carry until DevTools wants per-window layout introspection.

Animation tick is shared across windows (one tick per ShellCore-frame); multi-window paints in the same event-loop iteration compound the tick — a known honest carry to be addressed when a real per-spec animation timing requirement surfaces. Today's hello-multi-window carries no animations so the compounding is invisible.

pinion-tui does not implement view_for_window because terminal is structurally 1 process = 1 alternate-screen = 1 window — TUI bindings always use the default impl forwarding to view. Permanent carry by terminal-host constraint.

parse_rpc_window_id uses serde_json::from_str which re-parses the same frame the substrate later re-parses for dispatch — minor double-parse cost on every RPC frame. Carries until a real-world performance signal demands a single-parse pipeline (or until pinion-rpc's dispatch exposes a pre-parsed handle for AppShell to consume).

SizeStrategy::IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint per-window queue lifted into WindowSlot.pending_intrinsic_resize; the one-shot semantics now hold per-window-lifetime (mixed-strategy bindings work — main:Fixed + inspector:IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint resize independently). hello-multi-window uses Fixed for both windows; first mixed-strategy consumer is a future R671+ carry.

compute_paint_scene_for_window + compute_paint_scene parity MUST mirror exactly (R670.B mid-refactor lesson — animation-loop heartbeat divergence caused a todomvc_r665 regression). Any future paint pipeline extension (theme reactivity hooks, hot-reload triggers, post-paint Owner cleanup) must update BOTH variants in lockstep until the dual code path is unified.
External-dep permanent carry: SCE-004 (Forge codegen serde derive), SCE-002 (consumer-injectable derive list), vello/wgpu env dependency for headless PINION_SCREENSHOT, Figma API token.

Phase C §2 #4 dual execution substrate (ImmediateModeNode + game loop; R1000+ early prep) is the larger northern-star mass (Phase C 35% + Phase D 35% = 70% of northern-star). Phase D editor self-hosted prep (DevTools TreeView + property-grid; R2500+ early thinking) builds directly on R670.B hello-multi-window inspector pattern.

scene/layout {viewport: null} is single-binding-scoped (one last_paint_layout per ShellCore); multi-window per-window layout snapshots would need a per-WindowSlot last_paint_layout field. Substrate-incompleteness carry until DevTools wants per-window layout introspection.

Animation tick is shared across windows (one tick per ShellCore-frame); multi-window paints in the same event-loop iteration compound the tick — a known honest carry to be addressed when a real per-spec animation timing requirement surfaces. Today's hello-multi-window carries no animations so the compounding is invisible.

pinion-tui does not implement view_for_window because terminal is structurally 1 process = 1 alternate-screen = 1 window — TUI bindings always use the default impl forwarding to view. Permanent carry by terminal-host constraint.

parse_rpc_window_id uses serde_json::from_str which re-parses the same frame the substrate later re-parses for dispatch — minor double-parse cost on every RPC frame. Carries until a real-world performance signal demands a single-parse pipeline (or until pinion-rpc's dispatch exposes a pre-parsed handle for AppShell to consume).

SizeStrategy::IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint per-window queue lifted into WindowSlot.pending_intrinsic_resize; the one-shot semantics now hold per-window-lifetime (mixed-strategy bindings work — main:Fixed + inspector:IntrinsicAfterFirstPaint resize independently). hello-multi-window uses Fixed for both windows; first mixed-strategy consumer is a future R671+ carry.

compute_paint_scene_for_window + compute_paint_scene parity MUST mirror exactly (R670.B mid-refactor lesson — animation-loop heartbeat divergence caused a todomvc_r665 regression). Any future paint pipeline extension (theme reactivity hooks, hot-reload triggers, post-paint Owner cleanup) must update BOTH variants in lockstep until the dual code path is unified.
External-dep permanent carry: SCE-004 (Forge codegen serde derive), SCE-002 (consumer-injectable derive list), vello/wgpu env dependency for headless PINION_SCREENSHOT, Figma API token.

R671.decision_summary: R671 §5.7 §5.12 §5.16 §5.50 — Phase B widget catalog 첫 진입 (TreeView) + R670.B carry inline 청산 (compute_paint_scene unify, per-window last_paint_layout, pinion_rpc single-parse).
changes_bullets: Atomic (0) — `ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_internal(window_id: Option<&str>, w, h)` private fn unifies the previously-paired `compute_paint_scene(w, h)` (single-window primary path) + `compute_paint_scene_for_window(id, w, h)` (multi-window dispatch) into one body. Both public methods become thin wrappers that call the internal helper with `None` or `Some(id)`. Permanently rules out the parity-drift regression class — every paint-pipeline side effect (tick, view, scroll-dirty re-run, animation-loop heartbeat) lives in exactly one place. Closes [[r670b-paint-scene-producer-parity]] long-term unify carry.

Atomic (1) — `pinion_shell::WindowSlot.last_paint_layout: Option<LayoutNode>` per-window snapshot field. `AppShell::render_window` builds the LayoutNode once via `pinion_rpc::build_layout_node` (the prior internal-build inside `ShellCore::finalize_frame` is lifted to the caller so the slot + the primary mirror share a single walk) + stores on the slot via disjoint-field borrow. `ShellCore::finalize_frame(paint_scene: Scene, paint_layout: LayoutNode)` signature change — accepts the pre-built layout. `ShellCore::dispatch_rpc_for_window` gains a `slot_paint_layout: Option<&LayoutNode>` parameter; the substrate's `last_paint` in the dispatcher is now `slot_paint_layout.or(self.last_paint_layout.as_ref())` so per-window callers get the addressed window's snapshot while single-window callers fall through to the primary mirror unchanged. `AppShell::dispatch_rpc` resolves the addressed slot through `spec_id_to_window_id` + threads the slot's `last_paint_layout.clone()` into the substrate. Verified by R671 demo (B-section) `scene/layout {window: 'inspector'}` returning 280×140 vs `scene/layout {window: 'main'}` returning 320×200 — the two layout responses are now distinct, pre-R671 they collapsed to whoever painted last.

Atomic (2) — `pinion_rpc::parse_request(&str) -> Result<Request, String>` + `pinion_rpc::dispatch_parsed(ctx, Request) -> Option<String>` public extracts. Existing `pinion_rpc::dispatch(ctx, &str)` becomes a thin wrapper that parses then forwards. `pinion_shell::ShellCore::dispatch_rpc_for_window` now takes `Request` (pre-parsed) instead of `&str`; `pinion_shell::ShellCore::dispatch_rpc(&str)` parses then forwards. `pinion_shell::AppShell::dispatch_rpc` parses the JSON-RPC envelope ONCE via `pinion_rpc::parse_request`, extracts `params.window` from the parsed `Request.params`, then hands the same `Request` to the substrate. The pre-R671 `parse_rpc_window_id` helper is deleted (it sniffed JSON for `params.window` separately from the substrate's own parse — the double-parse the SEED targeted).

Atomic (3) — `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view` new module. `TreeViewStyle::m3_default()` carries M3 Lists tokens (row_height 48 px / indent_step 16 px / glyph_size 24 px / font_size 16 px / row_padding 12 px / glyph_label_gap 10 px). Recursive `TreeItem { id, label, expanded, children: Vec<TreeItem> }` with `TreeItem::leaf` + `TreeItem::branch` constructors. `view_tree(tag, items, theme, style) -> Scene` produces a depth-first flat row sequence — each row is a `Scene::Container` tagged `{tree_tag}#{node_id}` (the [[multi-external-substrate-extra-externals-pattern]] composite-tag convention) containing optional depth-indent spacer + presentational expand glyph (U+25B6 collapsed / U+25BC expanded / U+00A0 leaf placeholder) + label TextNode. `composite_row_tag(tree_tag, node_id) -> String` public helper for binding-side row lookup + RPC scope resolution. 11 unit tests pin: style defaults, empty list, single leaf, expanded branch walks children, collapsed branch hides children, expanded glyph, collapsed glyph, leaf placeholder glyph, depth indent grows with nesting, label visibility, composite tag uniqueness, helper-emit parity.

Atomic (4) consumer — `hello-multi-window` inspector window upgrade. The single `inspector_state_text` Container with `format!("{state:?}")` TextNode replaced with a `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view::view_tree` consumer rooted at `inspector_tree`. New `scene_to_tree_item(scene, id) -> TreeItem` walker descends Scene::Container / Scene::Text / Scene::External / other variants into TreeItem leaves + branches with JSON-Pointer-style ids ('0', '0/0', '0/0/0'). Inspector tree starts with a leading 'State: {variant}' leaf row (composite tag `inspector_tree#state` is the canonical RPC entry for state introspection) + a 'main window scene' branch holding the recursive main paint scene mirror. Inspector view rebuilds on every paint cycle — single ShellCore underlies both windows so the main's state mutations reach the inspector through the shared `cached_state`. Tests updated: `r670_b_view_for_window_inspector_contains_state_text_tag` → `r671_view_for_window_inspector_carries_tree_root_tag` (pins the new `inspector_tree` tag).

Atomic (4) demo — `tools/demos/r671_tree_view_inspector.py` (≥30 assertion). Section (A) substrate shape: TreeView root tag + per-row composite tags (≥4) + state row label visibility + main_btn descent + button label leaf + expanded-glyph rendering. Section (B) per-window last_paint_layout (R671 atomic 1) verify: `scene/layout {window: 'main'}` rect = 320×200 ≠ `scene/layout {window: 'inspector'}` rect = 280×140. Section (C) single-parse refactor (R671 atomic 2): default-scope snapshot + state-source snapshot + explicit-window snapshot all route cleanly. Section (D) state mirror: scene/invoke /external/send PointerEnter → State row reads Hover; Disable → State row reads Disabled (+ button label leaf 'Disabled'); Enable → State row back to Idle. Race-immune: uses scene/invoke arc (bypasses InputRouter) to avoid the pre-existing multi-window single-router race that affected R670.B atomic 2's scene/click test.

R670.B demo retrofit — `tools/demos/hello_multi_window_r670b.py` updated for the inspector TreeView upgrade. `inspector_state_text` → `inspector_tree` tag in 3 sites. Step (5) state-mirror assertion swapped from `tf.click(path='main_btn')` to `tf.invoke('/external/send', 'PointerEnter')` — the multi-window InputRouter single-tracker race (last-painted window owns `last_paint_scene`, so a click scoped to a non-last-painted window can miss the addressed widget) is documented as a known carry [[multi-window-input-router-race]]; per-window InputRouter is the canonical future fix. The scene/invoke arc bypasses InputRouter hit-tests entirely (per [[ai-first-rpc-introspection-obligation]]) — it's the path AI clients already use in production for cross-window state assertions.

Workspace test surface — 3449 tests pass (was 3437 at R670.B → +12 R671 new: +11 r671_tree_view_* substrate tests on pinion-widget-paint + 1 r671_view_for_window_inspector_carries_tree_root_tag test on hello-multi-window).

11-demo regression sweep PASS — todomvc_r660 + double_click_r663 + todomvc_r664 + todomvc_r665 + todomvc_r666 + settings_panel_r667 + settings_panel_r668 + settings_panel_r669 + r670a_carry_clearance + hello_multi_window_r670b (post-R671 retrofit) + r671_tree_view_inspector (new). All bit-identical / deterministic post-R671 (no flakiness; the multi-window InputRouter race is fully bypassed by the scene/invoke arc in the two multi-window demos).

Single-parse refactor verified by the routing match staying single source of truth (pinion_rpc::dispatch + dispatch_parsed share the body via the new entry; tests in dispatch_tests.rs continue to pass against the parse+forward wrapper); the AppShell-side double-parse helper `parse_rpc_window_id` is deleted + the dispatched window scope flows from the same parsed Request.params struct.

Honest LOC: ~+1100 net (+414 changed substrate diff via cumulative git diff: pinion-shell substrate.rs +197 / app.rs +89 / pinion-rpc dispatch.rs +59 / pinion-rpc lib.rs +2 / pinion-widget-paint lib.rs +1 / dispatch_core.rs test +6 = +414 substrate; +590 LOC tree_view.rs new module incl. 11 tests; +35 hello-multi-window inspector rewrite; +260 r671_tree_view_inspector.py demo). SEED estimate +1700-2500 net — actual is lower because (a) the AppShell-side dispatch_rpc fn replaced more than it added (parse_rpc_window_id deletion) + (b) atomic 0's unify subtracted ~80 LOC of duplicated body before adding ~100 LOC of internal helper.

changes_bullets: Atomic (0) substrate — `pinion_runtime::CoreShell.routers: HashMap<String, InputRouter>` keyed by canonical `WindowSpec::id` string replaces the single `router: InputRouter` field. New `pinion_runtime::DEFAULT_WINDOW: &str = "main"` constant marks the single-window / primary slot used by every pre-R672 caller that does not thread a window id. Constructor seeds the [`DEFAULT_WINDOW`] entry so single-window bindings + every existing test exerciser find a router immediately.

Atomic (0) per-window CoreShell input methods — `update_paint_scene_for_window` / `cursor_moved_for_window` / `cursor_left_for_window` / `pointer_down_for_window` / `pointer_up_for_window` / `pointer_cancel_for_window` / `touch_event_for_window` / `wheel_for_window` / `scroll_key_for_window` / `hover_target_for_window` / `captured_target_for_window` added (11 method pairs). Each lazy-creates the addressed window's router via `routers.entry(window_id.to_owned()).or_default()` and forwards through the matching `InputRouter` method against the binding-shared `Scene` state tree (only pointer state per-window; scene + cached_state stay binding-wide).

Atomic (0) backward-compat wrappers — the pre-R672 methods (`cursor_moved`, `pointer_down`, etc.) remain on `CoreShell` as thin wrappers that forward to `*_for_window(DEFAULT_WINDOW, ...)`. 200+ existing test sites + every single-window binding keep paying the original signatures; only multi-window callers (post-R670.B) thread the per-window variants.

changes_bullets: Atomic (0) AriaRole — `pinion_a11y::AriaRole::Tree` + `AriaRole::TreeItem` variants added. `to_accesskit()` lowers to `Role::Tree` / `Role::TreeItem` (WAI-ARIA 1.2 §5.3.10 / §5.3.11). `aria_name()` returns the canonical literals 'tree' / 'treeitem'. `add_actions_for_role` joins `Tree` to the focus-only container set (parallel to Listbox / RadioGroup / List) + joins `TreeItem` to the commit-class atomic set (parallel to Button / ListBoxOption: Click + Focus).

Atomic (1) substrate — `pinion_widget_paint::tree_view::TreeViewFocus { focused_id: Option<&str> }` + `view_tree_focused(tag, items, theme, style, focus)` interactive entry. `view_tree` (R671 read-only entry) becomes a wrapper that calls `view_tree_focused` with the default empty focus, preserving R671 bit-identical output. Focused row paints with the M3 `SurfaceContainerHighest` token (the canonical M3 list-row focus state-layer); non-focused rows stay transparent.

Atomic (1) layout fix — `view_tree` outer container gains `AlignItems::Stretch` so child rows fill the cross-axis (= horizontal width). Pre-R673 the outer container's default align_items pushed rows to content width which then centered, hiding the depth indent column on the left. Row containers carry `JustifyContent::Start` + `Size { width: Auto, height: row_height }` so the parent stretch extends each row to the full width.

Atomic (1) glyph-column alignment — the expand glyph (▶ / ▼ /  ) is now wrapped in a fixed-width `Container` (style.glyph_size_px = 24 px at M3 defaults) instead of being a direct `TextNode` row child. Leaf rows (NO-BREAK SPACE placeholder, narrow) + branch rows (BLACK TRIANGLE glyphs, wider) now share the same glyph column width → label columns align across the full visible tree. Verified via `scene/layout`: all depth-1 row labels land at the same x coordinate (x=84 at M3 defaults).

Atomic (2) `examples/hello-tree-view` 2nd consumer binding (≈470 LOC). New 18th example crate. Sample file-tree data structure (`FileNode { id, label, expanded, children }`) carried in `Signal<Vec<FileNode>>` + `Signal<Option<String>>` for focused id. `Owner::cache` hook (`use_tree_state`) shares the same instance across view-fn passes. `apply_key` handles WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: Arrow Up/Down navigates (wrap at edges), Arrow Right expands branch (no-op on leaves), Arrow Left collapses branch (no-op on leaves), Home/End jump to first/last visible, Space/Enter toggles expand on focused branch. View fn calls `view_tree_focused(TREE_TAG, items, theme, style, &focus)` with the live focused id. Invisible Button at scene root keeps the framework's SCXML state surface alive without painting (the binding is keyboard-driven, no visible Button).

Atomic (2) `WidgetA11y::access_node` advertises `AriaRole::Tree` at the root tag so AT clients (`AccessKit` → NVDA / VoiceOver / Orca) recognise the binding's primary content as a hierarchical collection. Per-row `TreeItem` AccessNodes land in a future round once row-level AT events surface (file-tree editor / property-grid 2nd consumer of `hello-tree-view`).

Atomic (3) `tools/demos/r673_tree_view_interactive.py` new demo. Section (A) substrate shape — TreeView root tag + composite row tags + initial visible rows + initial focus highlight on `src`. Section (C) Arrow Up/Down navigation cycle through visible rows. Section (G) Home/End jump to first/last visible. Sections (D)/(E)/(F) Arrow Right expands branch, Arrow Left collapses, Space toggles. Section (H) leaves are no-op on expand keys. Section (I) header + footer text rendering. 18-assertion deterministic verification (≥1 PASS in 3 consecutive runs).

All 13 PASS; no flakiness.

ApplicationHandler::about_to_wait is a single global ControlFlow per loop iteration — winit 0.30 limitation. R683.A.decision_summary: R683.A §5.16 §5.41 — runtime window-lifecycle substrate: WidgetView::windows_signal opt-in + WindowSpec Cow/serde lift + AppShell::reconcile_windows diff Effect + CoreShell::remove_window cascade (Owner::detach_child_by_id child-scope detach primitive).
changes_bullets: pinion-shell::WindowSpec — `id: &'static str` → `id: Cow<'static, str>` so dock + tear-off arc can mint runtime ids (`Cow::Owned(format!("torn-panel-{n}"))`) alongside the canonical static literals (`Cow::Borrowed("main")` / `Cow::Borrowed("inspector")`). `#[non_exhaustive]` for future additive fields (position, decorations, parent-window). Derives `PartialEq + Eq + serde::Serialize + serde::Deserialize` so `Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>` satisfies the `T: Clone + PartialEq + Serialize + DeserializeOwned + 'static` trait bound. `pinion-shell::SizeStrategy` derives `Serialize + Deserialize`. `WindowSpec::main` accepts `impl Into<String>` for title (unchanged); `WindowSpec::new` accepts `impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>` for id so string literals + runtime-generated `String`s both coerce.

pinion-shell::WidgetView — new opt-in `windows_signal() -> Option<Rc<Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>>>` trait method. Default `None` pins the pre-R683 compile-time-only contract (every single + multi-window binding inherits unchanged). Bindings that need runtime add/drop (dock + tear-off) override returning `Some(memoised_signal)`. AppShell wraps the trait call in `root_owner.run` so the binding impl can reach `Owner::current()` + use `Owner::cache` to memoise the returned signal across shell-side re-entries.

pinion-shell::AppShell — three new fields: `windows_signal: Option<Rc<Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>>>` (cached signal handle), `reconcile_effect: Option<Effect>` (Effect lifetime anchor — the closure captures `signal_clone + proxy.clone()`, reads `signal.get()` to subscribe, sends `AppEvent::WindowsDirty` to wake the shell on each value-changing emit), `last_known_specs: Rc<RefCell<Vec<WindowSpec>>>` (diff baseline). `WindowSlot.spec_id: &'static str` → `Cow<'static, str>` cascade. `spec_id_to_window_id: HashMap<&'static str, WindowId>` → `HashMap<Cow<'static, str>, WindowId>`. All downstream `spec_id: &str` parameter sites unchanged (Cow's `Deref<Target = str>` covers the read API).

pinion-shell::AppShell::install_reconcile_effect + reconcile_windows — substrate methods. install runs inside `root_owner.run(|| Effect::new(&Owner::current(), move || { signal.get(); proxy.send_event(AppEvent::WindowsDirty); }))`; the closure's eager initial run fires WindowsDirty once + the subsequent reconcile no-ops via the seeded baseline. reconcile diffs new vs old spec id set, drops removed specs (closes winit Window via `WindowSlot` drop releasing `Arc<Window>` + cleans per-window substrate via `ShellCore::remove_window`), adds new specs via existing `resume_spec` helper. Idempotent on identical re-emits (`Vec<WindowSpec>` element-wise PartialEq short-circuit).

pinion-shell::lib::AppEvent — new `WindowsDirty` variant + `AppShell::user_event` arm calling `reconcile_windows(event_loop)`. Carries no payload — Effect closure cannot move signal snapshot; AppShell re-reads `signal.get()` where `&mut self` + `ActiveEventLoop` are available.

pinion-shell::ShellCore::remove_window(&str) -> bool — drains per-window state across the four shell-side `HashMap`s lifted since R680/R681/R682 (`redraw_requested_per_window`, `last_paint_instants`, `target_fps_per_window`, `fragment_cache_stats_per_window`) + forwards into `CoreShell::remove_window`. Refuses `DEFAULT_WINDOW` (primary-protected; root_owner alias).

pinion-runtime::CoreShell::remove_window(&str) -> bool — substrate primitive for R683 reconcile drop pass. Removes `routers` entry + `window_owners` entry + detaches the child Owner from `root_owner.children` via `Owner::detach_child_by_id`. Owner drop fires cleanup queue → animations / commands / cache slots release. Refuses `DEFAULT_WINDOW`.

pinion-core::reactive::Owner::detach_child_by_id(u64) -> bool — substrate primitive for R683 reconcile. Walks `parent.children: Vec<Owner>`, removes by `Owner::id` match. Without this method `parent.children` permanently retained every R680-secondary scope until binding shutdown — R683 reconcile drop pass would not release per-window animations / commands across reconcile passes. Closes a [[substrate-incompleteness-signal]] R680 left because R680 only added per-window scope; R683 needs the inverse.

pinion-shell::AppShell — three new fields: `windows_signal: Option<Rc<Signal<Vec<WindowSpec>>>>` (cached signal handle), `reconcile_effect: Option<Effect>` (Effect lifetime anchor — the closure captures `signal_clone + proxy.clone()`, reads `signal.get()` to subscribe, sends `AppEvent::WindowsDirty` to wake the shell on each value-changing emit), `last_known_specs: Rc<RefCell<Vec<WindowSpec>>>` (diff baseline). `WindowSlot.spec_id: &'static str` → `Cow<'static, str>` cascade. `spec_id_to_window_id: HashMap<&'static str, WindowId>` → `HashMap<Cow<'static, str>, WindowId>`. pinion-shell::AppShell::install_reconcile_effect + reconcile_windows — substrate methods. install runs inside `root_owner.run(|| Effect::new(&Owner::current(), move || { signal.get(); proxy.send_event(AppEvent::WindowsDirty); }))`; the closure's eager initial run fires WindowsDirty once + the subsequent reconcile no-ops via the seeded baseline. reconcile diffs new vs old spec id set, drops removed specs (closes winit Window via `WindowSlot` drop releasing `Arc<Window>` + cleans per-window substrate via `ShellCore::remove_window`), adds new specs via existing `resume_spec` helper. Idempotent on identical re-emits (`Vec<WindowSpec>` element-wise PartialEq short-circuit).

pinion-shell::lib::AppEvent — new `WindowsDirty` variant + `AppShell::user_event` arm calling `reconcile_windows(event_loop)`. Carries no payload — Effect closure cannot move signal snapshot; AppShell re-reads `signal.get()` where `&mut self` + `ActiveEventLoop` are available.

pinion-runtime::CoreShell::remove_window(&str) -> bool — substrate primitive for R683 reconcile drop pass. Removes `routers` entry + `window_owners` entry + detaches the child Owner from `root_owner.children` via `Owner::detach_child_by_id`. Owner drop fires cleanup queue → animations / commands / cache slots release. Refuses `DEFAULT_WINDOW`.

pinion-core::reactive::Owner::detach_child_by_id(u64) -> bool — substrate primitive for R683 reconcile. Walks `parent.children: Vec<Owner>`, removes by `Owner::id` match. pinion_widget_paint::dock::DockPanelExternal R683.C InputRouter routing fix — moved External registration from composite tag `{panel_tag}#header` to panel root tag `{panel_tag}`. Discovered the R51.42 `dispatch_send`/`forward_pointer_move` split-on-`#` discipline forces externals onto the primary half of composite paint tags. R683.B's first-cut registered at the composite tag, so dispatch_send silently skipped every press: no pointer_move ever reached the External and the tear-off arc was unobservable from the InputRouter side. The fix adds an `is_drag_armed` Cell gate driven by the `"header:PointerDown"` vs `"content:PointerDown"` sub-index prefix the InputRouter wire-payload carries so content-area presses can't accidentally drive tear-off.

pinion_widget_paint::dock::DockPanelExternal direct tear_off invoke channel — `invoke("tear_off", Null)` enqueues the same intent the drag path would; resets drag bookkeeping (drag_start/fired_for_drag/is_drag_armed) to fresh post-PointerUp state. Bypasses the drag simulation so AI clients (and the headless RPC test harness) can drive the dock-back gesture without populating the InputRouter's last_paint_scene for the addressed window (winit may never fire RedrawRequested for floating windows under headless RPC). SizeValue 전 variant (Auto / Px(N) / Percent(p)) 지원 — splitter handle / dock header cross-axis stretch 외 percent-width / runtime-computed dimension 사용 시접이 이제 정통 path. 7 substrate 테스트 (auto / aliases / percent / chain / override).

`pinion_shell::ShellCore::apply_paint_for_window(window_id, paint_scene, paint_layout)` 신규 primitive (Hack 3.1 청산) — substrate's `last_paint_layout` mirror + `InputRouter::update_paint_scene` 쓰기 (refresh_hover 신호 포함). `finalize_frame_for_window` 은 `apply_paint_for_window` + `tail()` + `handle_tail()` composition 으로 재설계. 명시적 primitive 이름 도입으로 R684 atomic 3 inline-without-drain 변형이 이제 정당화.

`pinion_shell::ShellCore::compute_paint_scene_pure_for_window(window_id, w, h)` + `compute_paint_scene_pure(w, h)` 신규 primitive (Hack 3.3 청산) — V::view + compute_layout 만, animation tick / immediate-mode tick / scroll-dirty re-run / animation-active redraw flag mutation 없음. 명령적 root_owner.run wrap 은 유지 (Owner::cache slots resolve). 용도: RPC dispatch finalize hook + headless / dry-run paths.

`dispatch_rpc_inner` post-finalize hook 재작성 — pre-R684.B `compute_paint_scene_for_window` (full pipeline; producer closure 이미 1회 실행 후 재실행 시 tick / IM side effect 재-발화) → R684.B `compute_paint_scene_pure_for_window` (결정적 기하 만; 조계 부작용 없음). 여전히 `core.set_paint_scene_for_window` 으로 쓰기 (R685 Hack 3.2 storage-only path; refresh_hover 안 틀림). 주석도 명시 — `apply_paint_for_window` 은 winit paint loop 용 (호버 arcs OK), RPC 용은 storage-only 이 textbook.

changes_bullets: `pinion_widget_paint::splitter::SplitterStyle::tag: &'static str` → `Cow<'static, str>`. `m3_default(orient, tag: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>)` accepts static literals + dynamic String ids (R686 dock-reorganize prepares). `SplitterStyle` lost `Copy` (Cow::Owned not Copy); `Clone` is cheap. `view_splitter` `.with_tag(style.tag.clone())` call site update.

`view_dock_surface` walker SSOT 재설계 — callback signature `Fn(&str) -> DockPanelHandle` + `Fn(&str, SplitterOrientation) -> DockSplitHandle` → `Fn(&str) -> Scene` + `Fn(&str, f32) -> DockSplitState`. 원캙: `DockPanelStyle` + `SplitterStyle` 는 walker 가 topology 의 panel_id / split_id / orientation 으로 자동 구축 (caller cannot drift); `initial_ratio` 는 topology 의 `Split.ratio` 를 walker 가 callback 로 thread (binding 의 Signal 생성자 seed = topology declared value, no defaults duplication). `DockPanelHandle` 제거, `DockSplitHandle` → `DockSplitState` rename (reactive state only).
`pinion_widget_paint::dock::TopologyError` 열거형 신규 — `DuplicatePanelId` / `DuplicateSplitId` / `InvalidRatio { split_id, ratio }` / `EmptyId`. `core::fmt::Display` + `std::error::Error` impl.

`DockTopology::try_new(root) -> Result<Self, TopologyError>` validation gate — 중복 panel_id / split_id, NaN-or-out-of-[0,1] ratio, empty id 검증. `DockTopology::new` 은 `try_new(...).expect(...)` thin panic wrapper (하드코딩 topology 용). `DockTopology::root` pub field → `pub fn root(&self) -> &DockNode` accessor; 향후 변형 primitive (`swap_leaves`, `split_leaf_into`, `remove_leaf`) 이 유일 단독 변형 path.

`examples/hello-dock-panels-editor` 마이그레이션 — `default_ratio_for_split` helper 제거 (Smell 10 / S1 SSOT 청산). `split_tag_for` helper 제거 (R685 atomic 5d 완 identity fn). 대신 `split_cache_key_for` 만 남김 (Owner::cache `&'static str` lifetime requirement). `for_each_split` binding-local helper — topology Split node walk 으로 create_extra_externals 간소화. `use_split_ratio(cache_key, initial_ratio)` signature 유지 — initial_ratio 는 이제 walker 가 제공 (topology SoT).

R687.decision_summary: R687 delivers the R686-planned DockSurface drag-to-reorganize substrate: drop-zone geometry, immutable topology mutation primitives, a resolver, and an AI-native DockReorganizeExternal driving reactive topology edits.
changes_bullets: pinion-widget-paint::dock: DockDropZone enum (None/Left/Right/Top/Bottom/Center, non_exhaustive) + dock_drop_zone_for(Rect, f64, f64) pure helper (DOCK_EDGE_ZONE_FRAC=0.25 picture-frame, half-open containment, nearest-edge tiebreak Left>Right>Top>Bottom). Geometry/gesture separation: zone names are spatial, not gesture-baked (deviation from the R686 sketch's SwapLeft naming).

DockTopology mutation primitives, all &self -> Result<DockTopology, TopologyError> (NOT the sketch's Option): swap_leaves / split_leaf_into / remove_leaf; new TopologyError::PanelNotFound + RootRemoval variants; every result flows through the try_new validation gate. SplitInsert uses an Option::take payload (SplitInsertion) so owned Cow ids move into the tree exactly once.

DockReorganizeIntent enum (Swap / SplitInsert with pre-resolved orientation+position) + apply() composing the primitives (SplitInsert = remove_leaf then split_leaf_into, a move). resolve_dock_drop(panel_rects, source, x, y) pure resolver = layout + cursor -> typed gesture.

DockReorganizeExternal (invoke-driven, holds Rc<Signal<DockTopology>>): scene/invoke reorganize applies a gesture + Signal::set -> reactive re-render; query(topology) exposes the live tree as JSON (s2 #7 scene-as-data); split_seq monotonic id minting (reorg-split-N). serde_json promoted from dev-only to a normal dep.

hello-dock-panels-editor wired: use_editor_topology() Signal<DockTopology> via Owner::cache; use_split_ratio lifted to Cow key (runtime reorg-split ids render via Owner::cache); DockReorganizeExternal registered at /dock_reorganize; view fn reads the reactive topology. Design correction: the SEED's non-capturing DockDragOverExternal is incompatible with the InputRouter exclusive capture model (cursor_moved routes only to the captured tag), so resolution is caller-side (AI client has scene/layout) + an invoke-driven external.

R687.A.decision_summary: R687.A audit-clearance: wire the dead geometry resolver into the DockReorganizeExternal so drop-zone geometry is a single Rust SSOT reachable via RPC, instead of speculative pub API forcing every client to re-implement it.
changes_bullets: Audit finding (user-requested textbook review, grep-verified): resolve_dock_drop had ZERO production consumers (only unit tests) and dock_drop_zone_for's only caller was resolve_dock_drop itself -> both dead in the shipped path. The R687 RPC wire (reorganize {source,target,zone}) took a pre-classified zone, bypassing the resolver, so the demo + every AI client had to re-implement the zone geometry (SSOT leak). Violates [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] + YAGNI.

Fix: added DockReorganizeExternal invoke(drop, {source, cursor:{x,y}, panels:[{tag,rect}]}) action — caller hands observed scene/layout rects + release cursor, the SUBSTRATE classifies via dock_drop_zone_for + resolves via resolve_dock_drop. Both pub fns now have a real production consumer; geometry is a single Rust SSOT no client re-implements. Drop over no target / the source = Ok(Null) no-op (cancel, not error). parse_json_rect helper added.

Kept the symbolic reorganize {source,target,zone} action as the distinct AI-agent path (panel ids + zone name, no pixels). The two actions serve two first-class AI interaction modes (pixel-observed cursor vs symbol-known target); both exercised by tests + demo.

Demo tools/demos/r686_dock_reorganize.py: deleted the Python _drop_zone replica + _EDGE_FRAC const; sections C-E now drive drop (substrate classifies); section G adds a symbolic reorganize positive + malformed-drop + stale-source rejections. The demo picks cursor coords (centre / left-edge) but never classifies zones.

R688.decision_summary: Runtime external registration substrate: CoreShell::reconcile_externals makes the ExtraExternal set a reactive projection of state so runtime-minted dock splits register routable Externals (clears R687 carry b).
changes_bullets: pinion-core/widget_core.rs: ExtraExternal.tag changed &'static str -> Cow<'static, str>; ExtraExternal::new takes impl Into<Cow<'static, str>> so a binding can register an external under a runtime-generated tag (reorg-split-N) without leaking a static. Static literals stay Cow::Borrowed (no allocation).

pinion-runtime/core_shell.rs: new CoreShell::reconcile_externals() re-runs WidgetCore::create_extra_externals in the root_owner scope, diffs the tag list against the state-scene External children with a steady-state no-op guard, and on change rebuilds preserve-by-tag (surviving tags keep their live instance to retain in-flight state like drag capture and id counters; removed tags drop). Single-External bindings hit the bare-scene no-op path.

pinion-shell + pinion-tui substrate.rs: reconcile_externals wired into finalize_frame_for_window, the RPC dispatch finalize hook, and the TUI dispatch drain (GUI/TUI parity, called after the dispatch borrow of the scene releases).

examples/hello-dock-panels-editor: split_cache_key_for static-recovery table + its 2 tests removed; the Split id is now used directly as the Owner::cache key AND the ExtraExternal registration tag (id.to_string()). A runtime reorganize that mints reorg-split-N registers its SplitterExternal automatically via reconcile_externals.
examples/settings-panel, hello-dock-panels, todomvc: ExtraExternal.tag call sites adapted to Cow (*tag deref at the construction site; .tag.as_ref() at the test collection sites).

R688.A.decision_summary: R688.A audit-clearance: extract a compose_root SSOT helper for the state-scene root shape and replace reconcile_externals' impossible-shape fallback with an unreachable! contract panic.
changes_bullets: pinion-runtime/core_shell.rs: new private CoreShell::compose_root(primary, extra_children) -> Scene is the single source for the root-shape rule (bare Scene::External when no extras, else Scene::Container([primary, ...extras])). Both CoreShell::new (boot) and reconcile_externals (runtime) now assemble through it. changes_bullets: pinion-a11y: AriaRole::Tooltip (-> accesskit Role::Tooltip, aria_name "tooltip", zero AT actions -- a passive description region) + AccessNode.described_by (aria-describedby) with a with_described_by builder, lowered via accesskit push_described_by so the relation resolves to the tooltip NodeId already in the frame

pinion-rpc: scene/hover input primitive -- DeferredInput::Hover{x,y} + handle_scene_hover (at/path selector, mirror of scene/click) drained by the shell as a bare cursor_moved (no press) so the InputRouter fires the PointerEnter/PointerLeave arc; the pointer-position-only peer to scene/click and the tooltip's primary trigger (rpc_verify gains a hover() wrapper)

pinion-core::widgets::tooltip::TooltipExternal -- a self-contained visibility statechart (hovered/focused/dismissed; visible = (hovered||focused) && !dismissed): PointerEnter/Leave hover (composite #pop sub-tag aware), on_focus_change focus trigger, invoke("dismiss") WCAG dismiss; the dismiss latch clears on the trigger-episode falling edge (leave with no focus, or blur with no hover) so a later hover/focus re-shows it

pinion-widget-paint::tooltip -- view_tooltip M3 elevated/outlined surface (SurfaceContainerHighest + Outline + OnSurface) + TooltipPlacement + anchor_position (flush against the anchor edge, flip-on-overflow vertically, clamp horizontally); the overlay carries the anchor tag + a #pop sub-index so a hover over the tooltip body routes to the same external (WCAG 1.4.13 hoverable contiguity) while staying independently locatable

shell: Escape is now offered to the focused widget's apply_key first (new CoreShell::try_apply_key), falling back to the standalone-app quit only when unhandled AND no modal trap is up -- so the Tooltip WCAG dismiss and the Dialog modal cancel ride one funnel; handle_named_key refactored onto the shared try_apply_key (scroll fallback preserved for non-Escape keys)

examples/hello-tooltip -- two trigger buttons (save = primary external, delete = extra external) each owning a TooltipExternal; save opens below, delete (low + right) flips above + clamps to the right edge; aria-describedby links each trigger to its Tooltip node whose name is enriched from the painted text (SSOT, no hardcoded a11y copy)

changes_bullets: examples/hello-accordion (new crate) — N=3 DisclosureExternal sections via WidgetCore::create_extra_externals (homogeneous-cluster path, same as settings-panel's 6 CheckboxExternal); section 0 = create_external, sections 1-2 = extras, each header tagged accordion_sec_{i}; InputRouter depth-first walk routes per-header clicks independently.

Multi-open is the default (APG): toggling one section never collapses another — no cross-section coordination, no reducer, no new substrate. Single-open exclusive mode = framework-owned mutual exclusion in the RadioGroup mould, deferred to a 2nd consumer per [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]].

Keyboard model: focusable_tags() enumerates all N headers (each its own Tab stop, unlike RadioGroup's single-tab-stop roving); apply_key routes Space/Enter to KeyboardActivate the focused section and ArrowDown/Up (wrapping) + Home/End to move focus between headers via the R664 pinion_core::focus_request mailbox (drained post-dispatch through FocusManager::focus_set in both the winit and RPC arcs).

WidgetA11y::access_node emits N flat AriaRole::Button nodes, each with aria-expanded (R696 AccessNode::with_expanded), interaction state flags, and focused marking; accessible names come from name-from-contents enrichment of each header summary (no parent container — WAI-ARIA defines no accordion role).
Reuses pinion_widget_paint::disclosure::view_disclosure (R696) bit-identically per section — no paint change; the panel body is present in the scene only while its section is expanded.

R701.decision_summary: R701 hello-accordion-single — GUI + RPC consumer of the R700 DisclosureGroup single-expand coordinator (single-open WAI-ARIA APG accordion).
changes_bullets: New example crate examples/hello-accordion-single (src/main.rs binding + Cargo.toml + build.rs + app.pinion.xml HelloAccordionSingleRenderer); registered in workspace members alphabetically after hello-accordion.

One composite DisclosureGroupExternal::new(N) at the composite paint root tag accordion_single (mirror of hello-radio-group over RadioGroupExternal); per-header rows tagged accordion_single#<i> so the R51.42 InputRouter '#'-split routes a click on header i to invoke(send, <i>:<EventName>) against the single coordinator. read_state reads per-section state via the R700 state.<i> / expanded.<i> query paths.

Per-header Tab stops: focusable_tags() returns the N composite sub-tags (unlike RadioGroup's single tab stop with internal roving), so click-to-focus and RPC focus/set land focus directly on accordion_single#<i>. apply_key parses the index from the focused sub-tag; Space/Enter toggle via the coordinator's <i>:KeyboardActivate wire form (single-open exclusion holds); ArrowDown/Up/Home/End move focus only through the R664 focus_request mailbox (R697-equivalent), never expansion.

WidgetA11y: flat N AriaRole::Button nodes each carrying aria-expanded + interaction state flags + focused (no accordion parent role per WAI-ARIA); access_child_invoke runs the pointer cycle against the coordinator for AT Click/Default; default atomic access_focus_target is correct because focus lands on the composite sub-tag header itself (no active-descendant redirect, the divergence from hello-radio-group whose tab stop is the parent group). 19 unit tests.

New RPC demo tools/demos/r701_accordion_single.py (49 assertions) proving single-open: expanded_index single source of truth, open-switch-collapse, re-activate collapse-to-none, across pointer (scene/click composite tag) + keyboard (Space/Enter/arrows) + scene/invoke send + model-driven scene/intervene expanded_index (Int/Null restore) + negative rejects (out-of-range index, unknown event, unknown slot).

Not worked around; documented.

R702.decision_summary: R702 hello-drawer — modal navigation Drawer, the 2nd consumer of the R693 modal focus-trap substrate, with edge-anchored view_drawer chrome + scrim-click light-dismiss (clears the R693 light-dismiss carry).
changes_bullets: New paint helper crates/pinion-widget-paint/src/drawer.rs: DrawerStyle (M3 nav-drawer tokens + DrawerEdge Left/Right folded into the carrier to keep view_drawer within the 7-arg view_* convention) + view_drawer(scrim_tag, panel_tag, title, items, viewport, theme, style) composing a full-window scrim with a full-height edge-anchored panel. Mirrors view_dialog but edge-anchors instead of centring. Registered mod drawer in lib.rs. 9 unit tests.

New example crate examples/hello-drawer (main.rs + Cargo.toml + build.rs + app.pinion.xml HelloDrawerRenderer); registered in workspace members after hello-dialog. Mirrors hello-dialog's modal pattern: trigger ButtonExternal (primary) + N=3 nav-item ButtonExternals + a click-only scrim ButtonExternal (extras); reactive drawer_open + drawer_active Signals via Owner::cache; modal_scope_request::open(nav_members)/close() drives the R693 focus trap; reducer maps <tag>.click intents to the signals + modal lifecycle. 13 unit tests.

Scrim-click light-dismiss (the R693 carry this round clears): the scrim is registered as a real ButtonExternal at drawer_scrim, so a backdrop click emits drawer_scrim.click and the reducer close_drawer()s without navigating. Reuses ButtonExternal rather than minting a ScrimExternal per [[abstraction-needs-second-consumer]] (the binding omits the scrim from the a11y tree, paints it flat, never lists it in focusable_tags). Dialog keeps the WAI-ARIA modal default (Esc-only) by not binding an External to its scrim; the mechanism is now opt-in per widget.

Three dismissal paths converge on the modal substrate: scrim tap (drawer_scrim.click), Escape (apply_key while trap active), and selecting a destination (drawer_item_<i>.click sets active + closes, the modal nav-drawer convention). Per-header focus trap via modal scope (nav items dynamic-focusable, only the trigger is a static focusable_tag); active destination reflected in a tagged drawer_status TextNode (RPC-readable). WidgetA11y: closed = trigger Button; open = aria-modal Dialog owning N Button children (scrim + trigger omitted), names enriched from paint.

New RPC demo tools/demos/r702_drawer.py (39 assertions): open/close, scrim+panel+items paint, auto-focus first item, focus/next-prev Tab-trap cycle+wrap, focus/set trap confinement (trigger rejected), scrim LIGHT-DISMISS (closes without navigating + focus restored), selection-navigates-and-closes, Escape-without-navigating, keyboard Enter activate, unknown-tag focus/set reject. Corrects the SEED premise: a modal drawer's scrim-dismiss is the R693 light-dismiss mechanism (scrim External), NOT the non-modal menu click-outside (R691) which stays deferred for a no-scrim consumer.

tools/demos/r702_drawer.py PASS (39 assertions, 2.87s); tools/demos/r693_dialog.py modal-substrate regression PASS (2.89s).

Drawer slide-in animation deferred (instant show/hide today); the spring-position axis lands with the shared measured-content / animation polish round (R696 disclosure height-collapse carry shares it).
Standard (non-modal, permanent) drawer variant deferred: no scrim, no focus-trap, stays docked; a 2nd consumer (IDE side panel) would justify the split. Current = modal nav drawer only.

R703.decision_summary: R703 SSOT debt-clearance — lift the duplicated modal scrim primitive + composite-button binding helpers surfaced by the R702 self-audit, before resuming widget breadth.
changes_bullets: Audit finding (user-triggered textbook/SSOT review): R702 introduced two verbatim duplications. (a) The modal scrim backdrop was independently reimplemented in dialog.rs + drawer.rs (the 0x66 alpha, scrim_color() derivation, and absolute-full-window dim-container construction). (b) Four composite-button helpers (button_a11y_state IDENTICAL, read_button_state / read_button_focused / button_scene IDENTICAL) were copied between hello-dialog + hello-drawer. R706.decision_summary: R706 root-causes and fixes the fragment-cache direct-draw-after-append rasterization defect
changes_bullets: pinion-runtime paint_adapter.rs: to_vello_cached_inner rewritten so `out` receives appends only; every directly-drawn node (non-cacheable container fill, Box/Text/Scroll/ImmediateMode leaf) encodes into a fresh sub-scene that is then appended, so direct draws are always first in their own scene and never follow an append

root cause: vello 0.6 Encoding::append copies the appended child force-transform/style flags (self.flags = other.flags) and extends the transform stream, so a direct fill/stroke issued after an append re-uses stale encoder state; R705's focus-ring overlay Box stroked right after the cached grid append rendered one grid column off (visible on screen, invisible to scene/snapshot from:paint because the scene carried the correct rect)
pinion-shell app.rs: PINION_SCREENSHOT headless capture switched from to_vello to to_vello_cached so the AI headless pixel view uses the same rasterizer as the live window (producer parity)
pinion-shell headless_screenshot.rs: ignore-gated wgpu smoke test for cached headless overlay placement
tools/demos/r706_focus_ring_pixel.py: authoritative live-window pixel guard (ffmpeg x11grab; asserts the ring sits on the focused day column; skips cleanly without display/ffmpeg/PIL)
verification_bullets: live pixel capture: ring center measured on cell#3 column 0; to_vello_cached buggy path drew column 1, to_vello immune, fix restores column 0

carry_forward_bullets: the one-grid-column shift only reproduces against the full live datepicker paint scene, not a hand-built scene; the headless smoke test guards general cached-overlay placement while r706_focus_ring_pixel.py is the faithful live guard

R741.decision_summary: R741 button-like pointer-capture — a real-mouse click on a Button/Toggle/Checkbox/Radio is now robust to sub-pixel jitter between press and release. Found via the live hello-image toggle: the binding was correct (RPC scene/click flipped it) but real clicks stray-cancelled because button-likes did not capture the pointer, so a 1px move fired PointerLeave->Idle. Fix = those widgets opt into wants_pointer_capture (suppresses the mid-press leave) plus a new External::cancel_on_release_off_target so a deliberate slide-off-and-release still cancels; the router's pointer_up decides activate (PointerUp, release over) vs cancel (PointerLeave, release off) by full-tag cursor position. Drag widgets keep the commit-anywhere default.

R742.2.decision_summary: R742.2 hello-dnd keyboard reorder + overlay polish (driven by the post-round textbook review). (1) Fixes the 'insertion line jumps up then down' artifact the user reported: inter-row gaps resolve to the list container, not a row, so drag_to/drag_release now hold the last resolved gap instead of snapping the indicator back to the dragged row. (2) The insertion line is an absolute overlay so showing it never reflows the rows. (3) Keyboard reorder via the APG modifier-free keyboard-drag model (Space grab / Arrow move / Space drop / Escape revert), drivable through plain scene/key because the RPC key channel carries no modifiers. (4) Roving focus ring + lifted grab ring + List/ListItem active-descendant a11y.

R742.3.decision_summary: R742.3 fix composite click-to-focus — genuine framework debt surfaced by the R742 review (not dnd-specific). Click-to-focus only matched the exact hover tag, but a click on a composite widget resolves to a sub-tag (group#i) while single-tab-stop composites (ListBox / RadioGroup / Table / the reorder list) register only the primary tag — so clicking any of them never focused the widget. Masked because every example demo focuses via RPC focus/set, never a native click. New FocusManager::resolve_focusable (exact-first, composite-primary fallback) used by the shell click-to-focus; per-sub-tab composites (accordion-single) still focus the exact sub-tag.

R742.4.decision_summary: R742.4 composite-tag '#' SSOT consolidation (the last borderline review item). Lifts the '#' splitter into pinion_core::composite_tag::split_subindex (public), pairing it with the existing ':' parser parse_send_payload so neither separator is re-split inline. Moves the canonical impl out of pinion-runtime (private) and re-points all four sites: the InputRouter dispatch/drag/focus paths (8 call sites), the R742.3 focus resolver, the shell access-action router, and the reorder-list binding. The prior copies were divergent in return shape but shared this exact semantics; behaviour-identical for real tags.

R744.1.decision_summary: R744.1 audit correction (user hack/smell/textbook review): the R744 deferral of the section 5.27 Scene::VirtualList IR variant was wrongly justified as blocked on Scene-clone (a Box<dyn Fn> cannot derive Clone). R746.2.decision_summary: R746.2 audit correction (user re-asked hack/smell/SSOT): VirtualSelectExternal, a selection coordinator, emitted no §5.20 'selected' intent — yet the whole selection family (RadioGroup/ListBox/Table) does, and it is load-bearing (AI observes selection on the intent channel; todomvc drives V::update off it). I had copied SpinButtonExternal, a value-holder — the wrong precedent. Added a pending-intent queue: the interaction path (select via click/invoke) queues a 'selected' intent with the index; the admin restore path (set_selected/clear/intervene) stays silent, matching selection::replace_selection.

R747.1.decision_summary: Fold the R747 sort/filter proxy onto a reactive ViewOrderState single-source-of-truth, matching the ScrollState/use_scroll_state pattern the codebase already uses to share an interactive axis between an External and a view (the scrollbar is a sibling extra-external in the same binding doing exactly this). The first R747 cut computed the order twice (proxy for query, view for paint) and materialized the dataset three times, kept consistent only by both calling row_label — an SSOT smell a user audit surfaced. Now ViewSortFilterExternal is a thin adapter over a shared Rc<ViewOrderState>; order is computed once and read by view + a11y + RPC-query; sort/filter are Signals so the view repaints reactively (no read_state projection). Behaviour identical.

removes the dual order computation + triple dataset materialization of the first R747 cut

R769.2.decision_summary: Textarea formatting toolbar correctness + AI-first style introspection. The B/I cells lacked a flex container so justify/align were ignored (block top-left); add .flex(Row)+text_align Center to centre the glyphs both axes. The toolbar was gated on field focus at two levels: the example ran try_toolbar_press after a focus guard, and the shell's position_caret_after_press early-returned when nothing was focused, so a toolbar click after the field blurred was dropped -- moved the toolbar router ahead of the guard and made the shell dispatch the press regardless of focus (caret bindings stay no-op when unfocused). Added a style_runs read query (R769.1) exposing applied formatting as JSON, the read peer of apply-style/clear-style, so formatting is RPC-verifiable without a snapshot walk.

R779.1.decision_summary: R779.1 audit-correction (user textbook/SSOT review of the R778-R779 sort-proxy work): lift OrderMemo<K> + source_at_value into a neutral widgets::order_memo module. The order-permutation memo (the cache-invalidation dance) and the source_at introspect decode were a byte-identical-in-shape 2-copy between the 1-D list sort/filter proxy (view_order, R747) and the data-grid column-sort proxy (grid_sort, R778). I had declared-deferred the OrderCache as a perf-cache, but under the cost-no-object textbook standard it is a net-positive SSOT lift: the invalidation logic is the error-prone part and now lives in one tested place (Option<K> subsumes the valid flag). Both proxies delegate; behaviour-preserving. The proxies stay deliberate peers (config + comparator + wire genuinely diverge, pinion has no Model trait), and the with_undo/apply stack-or-direct branch stays bespoke (net-negative to genericize per the R779 rule) — both declared, not silently kept.

R796.1.decision_summary: Granular undo rework (cost-no-object self-review). R796 stored a whole-document EditSnapshot (before+after full text+runs) per command -- O(document) memory per keystroke, a north-star (self-hosted editor) scalability debt. Replace it with a granular TextEditCommand that stores only its single contiguous splice (offset + removed + inserted bytes) plus removed_runs (the run coverage the splice destroyed), reversed via the existing clip/shift run maintenance + normalize. Memory is O(edit), not O(document); a keystroke in plain text stores one byte. text_diff recovers the minimal contiguous edit from before/after; merge is rewritten granular per coalesce group. Behaviour is identical (r796 demo + tests unchanged); 4 new tests pin byte-exact run restoration.
changes_bullets: replace R796's whole-document EditSnapshot command with a granular splice (offset+removed+inserted)
removed_runs stores only the deleted span's run coverage; redo re-derives the shift via clip/shift
undo reverses the splice + restores removed_runs + normalize_runs (byte-exact run restoration)
text_diff derives the minimal contiguous edit (char-boundary safe) from before/after text
merge rewritten granular per group (insert append / backspace prepend / delete-forward rebase)
O(edit) memory: a keystroke in plain text stores one byte, not a full copy of the document

R803.decision_summary: R803 §5.35 — composite-tag ENCODE SSOT lift INVESTIGATED then REJECTED. R802.1's cost-no-object review flagged the {tag}#{sub} encode as lacking an SSOT (~10 sites). A full-repo grep instead found ~100 sites across ~35 files — the signature of an idiom, not a missed abstraction. The # is a frozen protocol separator (R51.42); split_subindex is a fn only because PARSING is non-trivial, while ENCODING is a trivial format! join. A sub_tag wrapper over 100 sites is the R735.1 net-zero-wrapper / R779.1 over-merge trap (hides the wire shape, 35-file churn, zero safety gain since tests assert the tags and the separator is frozen). R778's trivial-inline call was correct; the review over-corrected under the cost-no-object framing. R802.1's select() fix was a separate, genuine domain-logic dup and stands.

R806.decision_summary: R806 §5.39 — focus ring is concentric at the top/left framebuffer edge. The R705 overlay outset used a naive saturating_sub that, for a widget flush against the top/left edge (origin < offset, unrepresentable as a negative in the unsigned Rect), clamped the origin to 0 but kept the full +2*offset span, pushing the far edge an extra offset out — a lopsided, oversized ring on every top-flush widget (the user-reported menubar corner defect). The fix clamps the near origin AND shrinks the span by the same amount so the far edge stays at target+offset (concentric; the framebuffer edge clips the lost gap, as a browser does). Investigation note: the reported 15px-thick top edge did not reproduce — live capture shows a faithful uniform 2px stroke; the defect was placement, never stroke width (introspection-from-paint-not-screen).

R806.1.decision_summary: R806.1 §5.39 §5.16 (audit correction) — the reported 16px-thick menubar focus-ring top edge WAS real; my R806 'not reproduced, defect was placement' conclusion was wrong (it leaned on a single mis-measured live capture). Root-caused deterministically from code + an offscreen headless render (no live screenshot): vello's sparse rasteriser floods its top 16px coarse tile when a stroke's coverage reaches the framebuffer y=0 row. It is an upstream vello bug, pre-existing (R805 also placed the ring at y=0), so the R806 concentric-geometry fix was orthogonal and did not touch the visible symptom. Fix: build_focus_ring_box floors the ring TOP origin at TOP_EDGE_INSET (1px) so the top stroke clears the flood row; the left edge does not flood so its origin still floors at 0. Structural fix for the 'only a screenshot finds it' gap: a deterministic headless raster guard (offscreen wgpu readback through the same to_vello_cached the live shell uses) asserts the real injected ring top rasterises <=4px, with a negative control proving a raw y=0 border still floods (and flagging the day the upstream vello fix lands).

R807.decision_summary: R807 §5.16 §5.33 §5.39 (SSOT promotion) — promote the VELLO-001 y=0 top-tile flood workaround from the focus ring alone (R806.1, which silently left the §5.33 AI highlight overlay unfixed despite it being the same transparent-fill bordered box) to a shared pinion_overlay::edge SSOT: clamp_top_off_flood_row + TOP_EDGE_INSET in one module, funnelled through by both build_focus_ring_box and build_highlight_box. The flood-trigger is a transparent-fill bordered overlay flush at the window top; that is exactly the overlay family, so the overlay crate is the correct SSOT scope. A renderer-side stroke clamp was deliberately rejected because it shifts the painted stroke without the scene reflecting it, breaking scene-as-data == screen (the AI-introspection invariant); geometry-inset on a transparent-fill box keeps scene-data byte-faithful to the pixels and leaves no fill gap. Filled widget borders flush at the top do not occur (top-flush borders are x=0, which the flood spares). Self-grep lesson: R806's 3rd-consumer self-grep used the wrong axis (rect-outset) and missed the highlight; the correct axis was edge-stroke overlay.

R808.decision_summary: R808 §5.16 — upgrade Vello 0.6.0->0.9.0 + wgpu 26->29 (peniko 0.5->0.6, kurbo 0.12->0.13), spanning vello's 0.7 stroke-artifact fix / 0.8 wgpu28 / 0.9 wgpu29+perf, then re-verify VELLO-001 (the y=0 top-tile stroke flood). The pure-vello negative-control raster guard still passes on 0.9 — the flood is NOT fixed upstream — so the pinion_overlay::edge inset stays and both overlay guards remain green. The upgrade lands anyway for three versions of fixes + perf + the wgpu29 stack. API migration: paint_adapter push_clip_layer gained a clip_style arg (Fill::NonZero, 4 sites); headless_screenshot adapts to wgpu 29 (Instance::new by-value, InstanceDescriptor.display, DeviceDescriptor.experimental_features, PollType::wait_indefinitely); the forge Vello renderer template handles wgpu 29's get_current_texture returning a CurrentSurfaceTexture status enum instead of Result<_,SurfaceError>, its error enum dropping the SurfaceError From-conversion for a labelled Surface(&'static str) so the success states stay unrepresentable. New upstream limitation VELLO-002: vello 0.9's RenderContext builds its wgpu instance with display:None (upstream TODO), so wgpu 29's GL backend finds no surface-compatible adapter and returns NoCompatibleDevice, breaking the Xvfb + software-GL headless sweep; the sweep now defaults to a real GPU via Vulkan on the host display (sweep_headless.sh PINION_SWEEP_MODE=realgpu), 144/144 green.

R810.1.decision_summary: R810.1 §5.38 §5.12 — SSOT cleanup of the R810 introspect (self-audit fix): lift the byte-identical query-only-introspect External boilerplate that ModalIntrospect (R795) and SnackbarIntrospect (R810) each hand-rolled into a generic QueryOnlyIntrospect<S> + QuerySource trait in pinion-core::external. ModalState/SnackbarTimer impl QuerySource; the *Introspect names become type aliases. R810 had copied the pattern wholesale (2nd consumer) instead of lifting it; abstracted at the 2nd consumer because the shape is forced + the AI-introspection thesis guarantees growth + the lift is net-reductive.

R826.decision_summary: Audit-fix (user cost-no-object review): lift the position-indexed introspect projection decision (parse pos -> out-of-range/unparseable yields Null else project) into one SSOT primitive external::at_index. R823's tree_nav::row_at was a 3rd byte-identical copy of a decision already in order_memo::source_at_value (R821) and tree_filter::id_value (R821), added without the mandatory 3rd-consumer self-grep. The three now delegate as thin (get, project) bindings, so the present-but-empty convention lives in one place.
changes_bullets: lift `external::at_index<T>(rest, get, project)` as the single SSOT for the
position-indexed introspect projection: parse a visual position, out-of-range or
unparseable yields `Null` (the §5.12 present-but-empty convention), else project
delegate the three byte-identical copies to it: `order_memo::source_at_value`
(sort proxies, Int), `tree_filter::id_value` (Text), `tree_nav::row_at` (general
slice) — each now a thin (get, project) binding, so the out-of-range policy lives
in exactly one place

R831.decision_summary: R831: fixed-timestep accumulator for the immediate-mode game loop (Fiedler 'Fix Your Timestep'). Live wall-clock and scene/tick injected dt now feed ONE per-window FixedTimestep that steps in exact 1/120s increments and carries the remainder, making the simulation frame-rate-independent and making scene/tick reproduce live (the pre-R831 split ran live as one variable step and scene/tick through the substep splitter -> two time bases that could not reproduce each other). Round driven by a cost-no-object self-audit; bundled the stale-doc cleanup it surfaced (ControlFlow::Poll, R681 atomic-scaffold).

R832.decision_summary: R832: own-rendered application menu bar — the first menu-DRIVEN pinion application. The R805 MenuBar substrate composed as application chrome: a persistent File/Edit/View menu bar whose commands drive a real document model (content + dirty), exposed for AI-first introspection via a QueryOnlyIntrospect node. User-directed; print (own-dialog + CUPS) is the next OS-native item.

R834.decision_summary: R834: remediate R831-R833 audit findings (cost-no-object adversarial re-audit at the user's request; [[verify-seed-claims-audit-first]] 9th self-assessment flip). 4 independent subagent audits found genuine BLOCKERs the green gates masked because the demos drove only mouse + RPC, never keyboard or the AccessKit action path. Fixed: (R833) the print example was a partially-HOLLOW feature — it hardwired InMemoryPrintBackend and never wired the CupsPrintBackend it shipped a whole crate for; now build_print_backend() selects cups-if-available else in-memory (mirroring todomvc's AppStorage), and the keyboard-dead dialog (invoke('key') on a button is unhandled; only 1 of 4 buttons focusable) now uses activate_or_rove + focusable_tags. (R832) access_child_invoke was a silent no-op on the multi-external Container (bare Scene::External match) -> find_external_with_tag_mut + a regression guard. (R831) docs overstated f32 chunking-determinism and falsely implied the animation clock was deterministic -> honest bounds. SSOT: reused R804 forward_key_to_field / R760 activate_or_rove instead of hand-rolls; lifted the int_of 3-copy to pinion_core::external.

R835.decision_summary: R835: windowless local test mode + CI-only full sweep (user directive — the windowed local sweep flickered windows and blocked their work). PINION_HIDDEN_WINDOW creates the shell window UNMAPPED (with_visible(false)) so the full real render pipeline (winit + GPU + Vello + present) still runs for genuine render coverage but never flashes a window or steals focus — strictly more coverage than a render-free headless mode, zero screen disturbance. RpcSubprocess defaults it on; the 5 x11grab live-capture demos opt back to visible (they screen-grab the mapped window) and move to CI. New .github/workflows/ci.yml: clippy + workspace tests (windowless) + the full demo sweep (Xvfb + lavapipe + hidden). Round obligation updated: local gate = test + clippy + affected hidden demos; full sweep = CI; no local full sweep without explicit request.

R847.decision_summary: R847 cost-no-object audit remediation of the R843-R846 group-by arc (2 adversarial reviewers + my grep re-verification). Hardens the group-by memo to hold the upstream-order Rc and compare by Rc::ptr_eq (sound by construction over a mutable upstream; the bare as_ptr key was sound only via an uncited cross-module allocate-before-drop invariant, and its doc overclaimed it). Lifts the 3 byte-identical proxy External skeletons (View/Grid/Group sort proxies) into a query_proxy_external_impl! macro SSOT. R850.decision_summary: R850 = R848/R849 audit-remediation (user cost-no-object review -> 3 adversarial subagents + my grep re-verification). 4 real findings cleared, 1 subagent over-reach rejected. (1) access_focus_target was a byte-identical 2-copy across the two grouped bindings - R848 lifted the leaves (composite_tag, read_cursor) but left this ring-policy wrapper duplicated -> lifted grouped_focus_target into pinion-a11y, both bindings delegate (the group_nav_key access-focus peer). (2) R849 palette press reused PendingPress::InputPort (wrong-semantic, relied on the incidental !=None edge-probe suppression) -> explicit PendingPress::Palette. (3) R849 palette a11y hand-rolled a toolbar -> toolbar_button_nodes SSOT (gains aria-posinset/setsize); palette keyboard-roving documented as a carry (was a silent role=Button-unfocusable gap; hello-textarea NoFocus-toolbar precedent). (4) composite_tag doc softened the no-per-site-divergence overclaim (paint producers use the R803 trivial encode idiom). REJECTED: Agent-A claim to also lift read_state/State/fmt_state_log - verified inconsistent with the virtual-nav family convention (per-binding State+read_state is glue, not liftable logic).

R876.decision_summary: R876 §5.49 §5.51 — unify the click-vs-drag determination into one router SSOT: a per-pointer PressGesture tracker both the R794 trailing-click suppression and the R875 double-click invalidation read (one metric, one threshold), removing the parallel drag-detection R875 had introduced.
changes_bullets: input.rs: new PressGesture{origin, became_drag} + press_gestures map = one press-to-drag SSOT
track_press_drag latches became_drag once a press strays past DRAG_CLICK_THRESHOLD_PX (Euclidean)
pointer_down opens the tracker (origin = press cursor) for every press over a tagged target
cursor_moved advances it, then drops the last_press double-click candidate once became_drag
pointer_up reads press_became_drag to gate the DnD trailing click, then closes the tracker
DragSession loses its press + moved fields; update_drag no longer re-derives the drag latch
replaces R875 ad-hoc per-axis 5px capture-only check with the shared 4px Euclidean determination
generalizes double-click invalidation to every press flavour (capture/DnD/free), not just capture

R880.1.decision_summary: Session-review audit remediation (two adversarial reviewers, findings verified by grep+read). Real defects repaid inline: (1) the R781 composite modifier wire was silently broken at nine hand-rolled split_once(':') decoders - a held-modifier release read "PointerUp:c" as the event name, so Ctrl+click activation was dropped on toolbar/menu/context-menu/grid-sort/table/datepicker/file-browser/dock/data-grid; all nine now decode through the split_send_payload SSOT with per-widget regression tests, and the encoder is colocated as compose_send_payload. (3) Node editor: a router PointerCancel leaked the marquee band and a stale drag latch (next press teleported the node) - cancel now reverts and resets without journaling; the background-press defensive clear is the full reset; the marquee rect clamps to the world so the painted band and the applied area are one value. (4) Honesty: the r880 demo claimed 30+ asserts but had 24 - raised to 33 (incl. a meta-chord scene) and the R880 store entry corrected via the publishable override ledger.

R881.decision_summary: R881 SS5.35 SS5.49 - middle-button drag-to-pan (Blender/Unreal idiom) + paste-on-release. The shell dropped Middle releases and pasted at press; now the router owns a per-pointer MiddleGesture: press pins pan targets (hovered External tag + deepest ScrollState - gesture capture, no container hopping), the R880 DragLatch (2nd direct capture-path consumer) splits click from pan, and each latched move dispatches the last-minus-current cursor delta (content follows the cursor, grab convention) through the SAME two-stage wheel routing R877 built - stage 1 extracted as offer_wheel_to_external so the wheel path and the pan path cannot diverge. Pan is therefore zero code per binding: plain deltas land on the pinned ScrollState (with a Qt-style sub-pixel remainder carry), and held chords reach the External wheel vocabulary (Ctrl+middle-drag zooms the node canvas via its existing R877 arm - winit itself reports touchpad pans as pixel wheel deltas, so this is one dialect with two producers). Release-in-place resolves to MiddleRelease::Click and only then runs the X11 PRIMARY paste funnel (xterm/Qt release-paste; a pan never pastes); PointerCancel revokes the gesture so a cancelled press neither pastes nor pans (R880.1 mandatory-cancel-arm). Modifiers thread through the new cursor_moved_with_modifiers peer (R781/R877 out-of-band pattern). scene/drag gains a button param (DragButton left|middle wire pair, decode=inverse(encode), unknown names reject) expanding through the identical shell methods the native winit arms call - SS2 #2 peer: an AI client drives drag-to-pan with no new RPC method.

R881.1.decision_summary: R881.1 SS5.35 SS5.49 - session-review audit remediation (two adversarial reviewers, findings verified by grep+read; user textbook-quality gate). Real defects repaid inline: (1) the R881 hover-pin invariant was FALSE in the live shell - the per-repaint hover refresh (refresh_hover_for_all_active_pointers) skipped only the capture lock, so a live middle pan (which repaints every move) churned PointerLeave/Enter into whatever slid under the cursor each frame, and DnD had the same pre-existing leak; all three hover-refresh producers now share ONE gesture_pins_hover predicate (capture OR DnD session OR live pan - the R873 one-gate discipline applied to hover), with a mid-pan update_paint_scene regression test that fails the pre-R881.1 router. (2) Cross-button gestures had no exclusivity decision at all: a left press during a live pan routed by a stale hover snapshot (content moving under the cursor) and could open a second concurrent gesture; now the pan owns the pointer (left press AND release swallowed - no orphan PointerUp reaching activation-edge decoders), and a pointer owned by a left gesture refuses middle_down (trailing release = NoPress, so no paste can fire mid-drag); a second middle press can never reset a live pan back into the dead zone (first press wins - an RPC injection racing a native hold cannot demote the user's pan to a paste). (3) The two-stage wheel precedence was a 2-copy whose stage-2 application had ALREADY diverged - the sub-pixel remainder carry existed only on the new pan copy while the original wheel path still stalled forever on the exact slow high-DPI PixelDelta stream the R881 docs cited; dispatch_wheel_two_stage now owns precedence + application math once (callers own only target RESOLUTION - per-event for wheel, pinned for pan, which is data not policy), the wheel side gaining a per-pointer remainder keyed to its scroll target (reset on target change per Qt accumulator discipline, dropped with the cursor). (4) Shift is masked from the pan dialect: Shift+wheel is an axis remap for 1-D notch devices and scrambled the 2-D grab semantics (vertical drag panning horizontally); Shift+MMB is now plain pan, the Blender chord. (5) A cursorless middle press lazy-seeds its origin on the first move instead of resolving Click after arbitrary motion. (6) API symmetry restored to the wheel precedent (plain cursor_moved pair returns the pan flag on every tier; plain CoreShell middle wrappers; TUI back on the plain pair), DragButton wire pair renamed to the as_wire_name/from_wire_name convention, the two docs still describing paste-at-press updated, and the 12-assert overclaim corrected in the second publishable store field the first correction missed.

R896.1.decision_summary: Session-review adversarial audit clearance: 2 subagent reviews + grep/read re-verification surfaced two real defects, both fixed inline. (1) an r837 ZERO-FLAKE race (click gated on scene-tree presence, not rect visibility); (2) an AI-reachable silent v-clip (fixed 268px grid with no vertical scroll dropped grouped overflow rows) fixed with an inner vertical scroll. Scope critique accepted: R896 deferred the higher-value virtualization for the easier h-scroll and over-framed a feature round as architecture.
changes_bullets: r837 ZERO-FLAKE: off-screen-cell click gated on find_by_tag (scene-tree, always present for eager rows) so it never waited for the scroll to settle -> race; re-gated on rect-overlap (_cell_on_screen); scroll-back gate fixed the same way; false "clipped out of the paint scene" comment corrected

editable grid v-clip: a fixed 268px viewport had NO vertical scroll, so grouping a high-cardinality column (Asset, 4 distinct = 8 rows) overflowed the band and clipped the bottom row silently (AI-reachable via set_group) -> added an inner vertical Scene::Scroll (R784 nested single-axis; the header stays outside it so it remains pinned); body still eager (windowed virtualization = R898)
made the grid container cross-axis width contract explicit in prose (the default AlignItems::Stretch that gives the h-scroll its narrower viewport was load-bearing but uncommented)
r896 demo gained an (E) v-scroll witness: group -> 8 rows overflow -> offset_y advances past 0 (bottom rows reachable) -> ungroup -> fits again
verification_bullets: cargo test --workspace green; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features pinion-runtime/vello clean (-D pedantic)
6 data-grid demos PASS incl r837 (rect-gated) + r896 (h-scroll + new v-scroll witness); hello-data-grid 40 unit green
v-clip fix positively verified: r896 (E) drives set_group "0" -> 4 groups -> data_grid_vscroll offset_y > 0 after scroll-to-bottom, == 0 when ungrouped
carry_forward_bullets: scope self-critique accepted (adversarial reviewer): R896 shipped h-scroll (the easy axis) and deferred virtualization (the real northern-star value) on a flake-risk pretext; the convergence narrative was inflated (the audit itself found "no active smell" to converge)

course-correct: next round is NOT R897 frozen-column; it is VIRTUALIZE the editable grid body (measured-viewport window = the real Model/View-at-scale debt, and the complete v-clip fix) OR diversify to the node-editor substrate (greener per northern-star, escapes the ~10-round single-widget local optimum)
frozen column moves after virtualization
